courses.title: Strategic Thinking for Marketing Leaders
courses.description: By the end of Strategic Thinking for Marketing Leaders, you'll be able to apply strategic thinking confidently in Senior Marketing Manager work, with a working sense of where data-driven decision making fits alongside it. The course moves from core strategic thinking technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at data-driven decision making woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying strategic thinking to a real Senior Marketing Manager scenario
Practicing strategic thinking through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to data-driven decision making
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.description: Applying Brand Strategy is a focused course on brand strategy for people already working toward a Senior Marketing Manager role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying brand strategy on your own.

alternates.title: Advanced Strategic Thinking Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Strategic Thinking Techniques goes beyond the basics of strategic thinking, for people already working toward a Senior Marketing Manager role. It's built for people who already have some grounding in strategic thinking and want to go further.
